text: Great suction. This is a great alternative to drilling a hard to remove adhesive

product_metadata.title: LEVERLOC Shower Caddy Suction Cup NO-Drilling Chromed Bathroom Caddy Shower Shelf Suction Basket Powerful Heavy Duty Max Hold 18lbs Waterproof Shower Organizer Storage for Bathroom & Kitchen
features: DAMAGE-FREE & HASSLE-FREE INSTALLATION - No drilling, No screws, No holes, No glue, No tools to apply the shower caddy suction cup. Simply choose a smooth surface, take off the protective cover and push the board until you hear ""PUFF"", ONE second to complete the installation. Even a child can install this shower basket suction easily.

WARM TIPS - This powerful shower organizer works best for non-porous, impervious, smooth surfaces such as glass, mirror, polished metal, stainless steel, plastic board, wall tile, grainy granite, etc. Please remind that don't stick to a grout line and on the porous surfaces such as: wood, unfinished marble, porcelain, wallpaper, natural stones (such as Travertines), painted wall, etc.

SUPER SUCTION POWER - The suction pad of caddy for shower is made of anti-aging TPE material, which holds up to 18 lbs, works well even in wet or oil environment, like bathroom and kitchen. The dimension of the shower shelf for inside shower is 10.6* 6.7* 6.2 inch (L*W*H).

CORROSION RESISTANT - The shower shelf suction is applied with rustproof chrome-plated bracket. Non-fading, scratch-resistant and durable. You can take the bathroom organizer out whenever you need. Detachable design makes suction shower caddy cleaning easier.

SPECIAL DESIGN - There are many drainage holes in the bottom of the wall mounted bathroom shelf, let excess water flow away, allows all parts of your shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, facial cleanser and shaving cream to dry. The shower basket is removable and can be re-positioned for many times.
